title: Material Receipt Note (GRN)
context: Material Management › Procure-to-Pay (PO Flow) › Material Receipt Note (GRN)

cards.title: Database schema architecture, entity bindings, and keys of fGRN
cards.body:
fGRN is a mission-critical inventory transaction form operating in the MM module.
Header attributes persist in Inventory.IGRNMain with primary key DocNo and DocumentYearlyNo.
Line items map to Inventory.IGRNDetail capturing ItemId, AcceptedQty, RejectedQty, and Rate.
Associated batch and serial details write to Inventory.IGRNBatchDetail and IGRNSerialDetail.
Tax distributions are recorded in the centralized table Finance.TDCTransactionDetail.
Warehouse bin allocations write to Inventory.IBINCardDetail linked by GRNDetailId.
Entity state transitions follow DocumentStatus flags Initial, Release, and Authorized.
ModifiedDate and ModifiedBy columns enforce optimistic concurrency during concurrent edits.
Shared custom field values persist via masterdata.customfieldssave during transaction commit.
All child tables maintain foreign key integrity referencing the parent document header.
Audit trail triggers capture record modification history in Inventory.IGRNAuditDetail.
Transaction commits execute within serialized isolation levels to maintain inventory integrity.
The schema enforces unique index constraints on DocNo and DocumentYearlyNo to prevent duplicates.
Child tables utilize foreign key constraints with cascade rules configured to prevent orphan rows.
Audit triggers record modification history in Inventory.IGRNAuditDetail for compliance tracking.
Clustered primary keys optimize range scans when inventory reconciliation jobs query historical receipts.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.

cards.title: Stored procedure bindings for search, load, save, and delete in fGRN
cards.body:
Data operations on fGRN execute through specialized inventory stored procedures in the database.
Search queries invoke Inventory.IGRNSearchData to return filtered receipt header records.
Record loading executes through Inventory.IGRNLoadData and Inventory.IGRNItemIndentDetail.
Transaction persistence is orchestrated by the master save routine sp inventory.igrnsave.
Validation rules execute server-side via Inventory.IGRNCustomValidation before data writing.
Record removal is governed by Inventory.IGRNDelete which validates downstream references.
Lookup values and dependent filters populate using Inventory.IGRNFillValues procedures.
Vendor profile parameters load through GlobalData.VendorLocationSelect lookup procedures.
Stock valuation and finance voucher generation invoke Inventory.IGRNFinancePosting.
Structured error codes returned by procedures are translated into UI notifications.
All procedures execute within explicit transaction blocks with rollback on error.
Diagnostic shortcuts Ctrl+Alt+G copy database update scripts to the clipboard for review.
Stored procedures utilize table-valued parameters to perform efficient bulk line insertions.
Execution errors invoke structured catch blocks that execute explicit transaction rollbacks.
Lookup procedures implement indexed queries to retrieve open references with sub-second latency.
Procedure performance execution plans are cached by the relational database engine to minimize query compilation overhead.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.
Database triggers intercept unauthorized data manipulation attempts and enforce strict referential boundaries across schemas.

cards.title: Backend validation triggers and error conditions enforced by fGRN
cards.body:
fGRN enforces rigorous data integrity constraints prior to executing persistence routines in the database.
AcceptedQty > (BalancePOQty + ToleranceQty) fires an immediate validation exception on save.
Selecting a GateEntryNo already bound to an active IGRNMain record triggers duplicate errors.
Mismatched currencies across multiple selected PO references aborts the save operation.
ChallanDate > DocumentDate or VendorBillDate > DocumentDate triggers date validation refusal.
DocumentStatus == Authorized halts save attempts with Authorized Entry can't be updated.
Division month-lock flags in masterdata.mDivision lock tables prevent transaction authorization.
Missing warehouse selections on detail rows abort processing when warehouse flags are active.
Negative or zero conversion factors on dual-unit items trigger conversion calculation errors.
Validation routines execute within client pre-checks and server validation procedures.
Inspection pending flags block authorization when quality inspection checks are mandated.
Structured error messages identify the exact line item and column violating business constraints.
Validation rules query database indices to evaluate balance quantities without table scans.
Server procedures re-verify all Boolean conditions to prevent bypass via direct API requests.
Failed checks raise custom error codes mapped to localized user error messages in the interface.
Rollback handlers reverse all temporary table states when validation failures occur.

cards.title: Detail line replacement architecture and atomic transaction boundaries
cards.body:
Editing existing fGRN documents utilizes a detail replacement mutation pattern in the database.
Existing child rows in Inventory.IGRNDetail and related tables are purged within the transaction.
Current screen state lines are inserted anew, generating sequential DetailRowId values.
Atomic transaction boundaries ensure header updates and child re-insertions commit together.
If any validation rule or database trigger fails, the entire transaction rolls back.
Cascade handlers first revert upstream PO and indent consumed balances to prior states.
The newly inserted lines then apply updated consumption quantities to parent records.
Audit log triggers capture deleted rows into historical archive tables prior to replacement.
Concurrency timestamps prevent detail replacement if another user modified the document.
This pattern guarantees that inventory balances never drift due to partial data commits.
Detail line replacement executes synchronously with parent document updates.
Foreign key constraints ensure orphaned child rows cannot persist after update execution.
Detail line replacement executes synchronously with parent document updates in the database.
Transaction isolation levels prevent concurrent transactions from reading partially replaced rows.
Audit history logs capture deleted line item details before replacement occurs.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.

cards.title: Stock ledger mutation and financial voucher interface upon authorization
cards.body:
Document authorization executes dual-ledger posting via Inventory.IGRNFinancePosting in the database.
Physical on-hand inventory increments within Inventory.IStockLedger for accepted item lines.
Valued inward entries evaluate item valuation methods FIFO, Weighted Average, or Standard.
Concurrently, Account Determination Rules (ARD) resolve inventory asset and clearing accounts.
Staging tables in the Finance schema receive valued lines to support Purchase Bill matching.
If inspection rejected quantities exist, quarantine stock ledgers isolate the material.
Database triggers prevent stock postings if inventory periods are closed for the division.
Voucher IDs generated in Finance write back to IGRNMain to establish audit lineage.
Rollback handlers reverse stock additions if financial staging generation encounters errors.
Financial postings maintain double-entry balancing invariants between inventory and clearing ledgers.
Stock ledger updates capture batch IDs, serial numbers, and physical warehouse bin assignments.
This posting interface ensures exact synchronization between physical inventory and the General Ledger.
Valuation procedures compute moving weighted average rates dynamically during stock ledger commit.
Posting routines write staging rows consumed by accounts payable matching procedures in Finance.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.
Database triggers intercept unauthorized data manipulation attempts and enforce strict referential boundaries across schemas.

cards.title: Concurrency controls, optimistic locking, and referential barriers
cards.body:
fGRN enforces optimistic concurrency to maintain consistency in multi-user environments.
When saving, the procedure compares the client ModifiedDate with the database record timestamp.
If another session modified the receipt, the server returns Someone updated this record.
Referential integrity barriers prevent document deletion once downstream processes engage.
If a Purchase Bill in Finance.fPurchaseBill references the GRN DocNo, deletion is blocked.
If quality inspection entries exist in Inventory.IInspectionEntry, removal is disallowed.
Authorized receipts cannot be deleted or un-authorized through standard application interfaces.
Line cancellation routines must be utilized to process return dispatch challans for rejected goods.
Security audit tables log all authorization, update, and deletion attempts with user session data.
Database triggers enforce referential barriers across Purchase, Inventory, and Finance schemas.
Optimistic locking prevents lost updates during simultaneous warehouse intake processing.
Audit trails preserve complete historical snapshots of receipts for statutory compliance.
Referential integrity barriers protect historical receipts from accidental administrative removal.
Relational constraints and clustered indices optimize query execution plans during high-volume database operations.
Database triggers intercept unauthorized data manipulation attempts and enforce strict referential boundaries across schemas.
Transaction logs capture user connection parameters and execution timestamps to maintain comprehensive enterprise auditability.
